summary: PRA Group filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 announcing the pricing of $400.0 million aggregate principal amount of 8.500% senior notes due 2033 in a private Rule 144A/Regulation S offering. The notes are guaranteed on a senior unsecured basis by existing and future domestic subsidiaries that are borrowers or guarantors under the North American Credit Agreement. Expected closing is on or about October 2, 2026, subject to customary conditions. Net proceeds plus available cash will repay approximately $400.0 million of North American revolving credit facility borrowings. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation; watch leverage and interest cost.
